"    public RealMatrix getCovariances(RealMatrix data) {",

"        int nObs = data.getRowDimension();",

"        double[] means = new double[nVars];",

"                covariances.setEntry(i, j, covariance);",
"                covariances.setEntry(j, i, covariance); // Covariance matrix is symmetric",
"            }",
"        }",
